text_block_list.text:
Having happened upon some discount 
coupons, I went to the cinema today with 
Tazuna-san.
Just then, Tazuna-san's demeanor—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer! Did you know about 
this?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, this movie theater just 
finished a massive equipment overhaul 
recently!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The sound quality got so, sooo much 
better!! Apparently, they handed out 
discount coupons to celebrate too.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A massive screen and powerful acoustics— 
that really is the best part of going to 
the movies~!
choice_data_list: I didn't know you loved movies so much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, actually♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, we still haven't 
decided what movie to watch today, have 
we?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not picky about genres at all! Which 
one should we go with~?
choice_data_list:
"Eyes on the Ball, Reaching for the Sky: A 
Hot-Blooded Baseball Story!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, a spy-themed piece...! Yes, yes! 
That sounds thrilling and fun!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone masterfully handle a hidden 
persona... kind of makes you look up to 
them, doesn't it...? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear. Excuse me, would it be alright 
if I went to buy a towel?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: B-Because... because!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm de-fi-nite-ly gonna cry...!! A 
handkerchief won't even be enough!!

...And with all that, Tazuna-san and I 
thoroughly enjoyed the movie.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was so much fun...! Thank 
you so much for inviting me today.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've been so busy lately that I haven't 
had the chance to visit... Getting to 
immerse myself in the world of movies for 
the first time in a while made me so 
happy♪
choice_data_list: You really do love movies, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The movies themselves are 
wonderful, of course, but... how should I 
put it, I simply love the "movie theater" 
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With smartphones and the internet 
evolving, we can now enjoy works anytime 
and anywhere, but――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Riding the train all the way out here, 
going to the trouble of buying a ticket, 
sinking into the seat, waiting while the 
trailers roll...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for the gate to open brings this 
incredible rush of excitement... I just 
can't get enough of it...♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Ah. No, um...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa there! This is our stop, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll take my leave here! Please 
get home safely.

After seeing off Tazuna-san for a moment, 
I happened to look up at the screen in 
front of the station――

"Leaving an indelible impression behind, 
she stepped away from the turf. Her legend 
continues to be told to this very day――"

"The 'Phantom Umamusume' revival screening 
has been confirmed."
